intro: Kenya stretches from Indian Ocean beaches over savanna and the Great Rift Valley to snowy Mount Kenya.

chapters.title: Rift Valley and highlands
text: The Great Rift Valley cuts through Kenya, with lakes full of flamingos. Mount Kenya, 5,199 m, is Africa's second-highest mountain and sits on the equator. The highlands have rich farmland.
The Maasai Mara hosts the Great Migration of wildebeest from Tanzania each year.

chapters.title: North and coast
text: The north is dry, with Lake Turkana, the world's largest desert lake. The coast has coral reefs and mangroves.

keyTerms.meaning: A valley formed where the Earth's crust pulls apart.
The yearly movement of millions of wildebeest and zebra.
